runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0e947fdfcffe4BbVX1z2wf8L1R] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026:

**Query:** `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` via `clickhouse-refined`

**Result:** **7,180 blocks** across the day. For each block:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `slot` | Beacon slot number (range ~14590498–14597998) |
| `block_root` | Beacon block root hash |
| `first_seen_ms` | Minimum ms from slot start when any node first saw the block |
| `first_seen_time` | Wall clock UTC arrival time (slot_start + first_seen_ms) |

**Key stats:**
- Fastest arrivals: ~200–500 ms (e.g. slot 14597916 at 215ms, slot 14597832 at 522ms)
- Typical arrivals: ~1,200–1,600 ms
- Slowest: up to ~3,600 ms (e.g. slot 14597754 at 3,600ms)
- ~6,000 blocks (84%) arrived within 2,000 ms of slot start

The data shows healthy propagation — the vast majority of mainnet blocks were first seen within 2 seconds of their slot start time.

**Path:** `/home/runner/.panda/data/storage/4ead333893e8/47160646-fdcb-4ec7-8369-8c03b9ab50af/arrival_distribution.png`
